question: Look for FDA safety communications about montelukast. Summarize only the returned notice titles or excerpts, link to them, and explain if full notice text was not retrieved. No personal treatment recommendations.
answer:
FDA’s current Drug Safety Communications index returned one montelukast notice:

- **“FDA requires Boxed Warning about serious mental health side effects for asthma and allergy drug montelukast (Singulair); advises restricting use for allergic rhinitis”** — dated **March 4, 2020**.  
  [FDA notice](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-requires-boxed-warning-about-serious-mental-health-side-effects-asthma-and-allergy-drug)

**Retrieval limitation:** The search returned the notice title and link only. The full notice text was **not retrieved**, so no additional excerpts or details are summarized here. The search covered the current FDA index and does not establish that no other historical communications exist.

Informational only; not medical advice.
